hook.captionText: You're one sentence away from blanking.

escalationBeats.captionText:
"How's your dog doing?"
They have a cat.
Forgets their name before the handshake ends.

"How's your girlfriend?"
They broke up in March.

Can't remember his kid's name.
Again.
Still has no idea what she does for work.

Wished her happy birthday.
Three months early.

revealText: What if you never forgot the little things about people again?

bullets: Remember names, pets, family, interests, birthdays
Stay genuinely thoughtful — without relying on memory alone

endingTagline: Because people remember when you remember.
